title: Evidence-first retrieval
caption: Illustrative example of an original educational workflow, not a published method or an empirical result. Both retrieval branches search a shared collection and converge at a reranker. Selected passages enter an evidence pack, which supports generation together with the original question. The answer cites the pack and reports uncertainty when evidence is insufficient.

sources.quote: A user question is the input.
Both branches search the same document collection.
Use a shared corpus above the retrieval branches with links to both branches.
